title: Canonical supported constant site-exchange map
statement:
Let $Z,X$ be schemes [def-pc-scheme] in object universe $u$ and let $A$ be a commutative ring in universe $u+1$ [def-weil-size-convention]. For $s=\mathrm{et},\mathrm{proet}$ use the existing small sites and their topologies [def-weil-pbc-etale-site] [def-weil-pbc-proetale-site], with ordinary fixed-$A$ module sheaves $\operatorname{Mod}_s(T,A)$ [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category] and constant coefficient module $A_{T,s}$ [def-weil-pbc-constant-sheaf]. For a scheme morphism $i:Z\to X$, write $i_s^*\dashv i_{s,*}$ for the existing inverse/direct-image adjunctions [def-weil-pbc-inverse-image] [def-weil-proetale-inverse-image] [def-weil-pbc-direct-image] [def-weil-proetale-module-direct-image]. Put $P_{s,i}=i_{s,*}A_{Z,s}$ and define the constant restriction $\rho_{s,i}:A_{X,s}\to P_{s,i}$ as the adjunction transpose of the canonical scalar-preserving constant identification $i_s^*A_{X,s}\cong A_{Z,s}$.

Write $C_T=\nu_T^*$ for the etale-to-pro-etale comparison inverse image [def-weil-pbc-site-comparison-morphism], $q_T:C_T A_{T,\mathrm{et}}\xrightarrow{\sim} A_{T,\mathrm{proet}}$ for its canonical constant-unit identification, and $k_i:C_Z i_{\mathrm{et}}^*\xrightarrow{\sim}i_{\mathrm{proet}}^*C_X$ for the coherent inverse-image comparison of that morphism of sites [def-per-site-comparison-pullback-data]. Define $\gamma_{A,i}:C_X P_{\mathrm{et},i}\to P_{\mathrm{proet},i}$ to be the adjunction transpose under $i_{\mathrm{proet}}^*\dashv i_{\mathrm{proet},*}$ of
$$i_{\mathrm{proet}}^* C_X P_{\mathrm{et},i}\xrightarrow{k_i^{-1}} C_Z i_{\mathrm{et}}^*i_{\mathrm{et},*}A_{Z,\mathrm{et}}\xrightarrow{C_Z(\mathrm{counit})}C_Z A_{Z,\mathrm{et}}\xrightarrow{q_Z}A_{Z,\mathrm{proet}}.$$
This defines the actual canonical site-exchange map and its plain components for arbitrary $i$; the closed-immersion case is its specialization. No invertibility or normalization theorem is asserted by this definition.
